pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on brushing teeth to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on brushing teeth.
   D. Say Hadith on brushing teeth has no place in daily life.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on Etiquette of Eating to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Etiquette of Eating.
   D. Say Hadith on Etiquette of Eating has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character..

6. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Attributes of Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Attributes of Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of Allah.
   D. Say Attributes of Allah has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Swalah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Pillars of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Pillars of Swalah has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Use Wudhu to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wudhu.
   C. Say Wudhu has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Wudhu with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara Types of Najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Twahara Types of Najasaat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara Types of Najasaat.
   D. Say Twahara Types of Najasaat has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Fitness? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Fitness.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Fitness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on Fitness has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on Fitness to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Conditions for Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Conditions for Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Conditions for Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conditions for Swalah.
   D. Say Conditions for Swalah has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru.
   C. Say Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Fitness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Attributes of Allah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in Angels Atid, and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Belief in Angels Atid,; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
